title: woodsia polystichoides f. veitchii
intro: Woodsia polystichoides f. veitchii, commonly known as the Veitch's Woodsia fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Woodsiaceae. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and vasodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Woodsia polystichoides f. veitchii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibiting immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory activities. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
